menus.note: Published price columns transcribed after visual PDF review; dine-in prices are primary and separately printed takeaway totals are in item notes. Sweet-potato rice latte is ¥660/¥648, not the neighboring ¥682/¥669 variants. Rice meals start at 10:00 and may sell out; food last order 17:30, one order per person. Regular food-plus-drink ¥50 benefit is printed; no stacking with anniversary benefit inferred. Decaf coffee is available at the same price but is not the original blend. Sweets cabinet rotates and has no named fixed roster/prices in this PDF. Current dated October/November notices supersede homepage image’s old 10:00–19:00 hours.

menus.label: 7th ANNIVERSARY FESTA — rice-flour menu
menus.note: October 27–31, 2026, 09:00–18:00. Event products sold at the exact cafe; individual prices not published. Operator event page confirms ¥50 off a drink when bought together with a seventh-anniversary item. No additional stacking discount promised. Baking workshop is separate, not a dining menu. Operator pages conflict on reusable-tumbler drink benefit (¥20 vs ¥100); that benefit is excluded pending clarification.
